title: Qualify and advertise soft-body contact
requires: Each driver that will advertise either soft-body scope
scope: Run public-API surface, binding, conservation, capacity and lifecycle gates before exposing self or pair contact.
acceptance: Folded-self, two-volume, high-speed, friction, binding-resolution and long-run cases pass per advertising driver.
